integrity: The open primary article was inspected at the definition of partial sharing, Theorem 2.1, Example 2.2, and the proof step deriving the Riccati equation from the two Picard exceptional values. Necessity follows by Vieta from that verified equation. Sufficiency was independently reconstructed by an explicit Möbius-exponential solution and exact differentiation; the complete set of finite partially shared values follows from a polynomial identity. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns four distinct nonzero finite values partially shared with the first derivative by meromorphic functions on the plane. It uses the source's four-value classification as a premise and does not resolve the source's more complicated three-value problem. A symmetric value set can admit more than one equal-product pairing, giving more than one possible exceptional-pair realization.
title: Equal-product classification of four partially shared derivative values
